resources.string: Two buttons: Fold/Unfold Toggle · Dual-Screen Mode
Cover screen exclusive: Fold/Unfold · Dual-Screen Mode · One-Tap Cast · Adaptive Rotation
Spin the 3-slot lever to score points; tap the score counter to switch to three shortcut buttons
Cover screen exclusive: Spin for points; score counter can switch to three shortcut buttons
Tap the lever on the right to spin
Tap slot for function · Tap lever for settings
Assign a toggle function to each of the three slots; tap a slot to execute its action.
Cover screen exclusive: Four buttons each assigned an action, pick whatever you like
Four buttons each assigned an action, tap a slot to execute. Tap an empty slot to configure.

Adaptive Rotation automatically rotates the inner screen orientation based on the app\'s portrait/landscape state, designed for handheld portable monitors.\n\nThe display may rotate by 90 degrees overall; do not enable on fixed-orientation monitors.
Cover screen exclusive: Battery, CPU temperature, RAM usage, storage usage
App launcher for the cover screen: icon grid, tap to launch directly on that screen
No apps selected yet\nTap the gear icon on the top bar to pick some
Remove all checked apps from the launcher?
Detected an existing cover screen app list in the system (%1$d apps). Import this list?\n\nImporting will overwrite currently selected apps.
No importable list found. This device might not have used the system\'s built-in cover screen launcher widget.
Failed to read app list; ensure Shizuku is authorized
Unable to read this image, please try another
Type a few letters to search
Tap icon to show/hide · Long press to favorite or uninstall · Drag to sort
Favorites only · Long press to favorite or uninstall · Drag to reorder
This will remove the app from your phone and clear its records from the launcher and favorites.
Shizuku authorization required to uninstall apps
Release to drop · Drag to end to auto-scroll
Sorting disabled during search; clear search bar before dragging
Import the entire existing list from the system (will overwrite current selections)
Export Current Order to Secondary Screen Desktop
Write the current selected order to secondary screen desktop in one go; after writing, both operate independently without auto-syncing
Exported order of %1$d apps to Secondary Screen Desktop
No apps selected yet, nothing to export
Secondary Screen Desktop does not have its own order yet — organize in launcher, then tap \"Import → Export Current Order to Secondary Screen Desktop\"
The external screen rotates together with the phone with matching orientation, leaving no black borders after rotation. This is the core feature of this app.\n\nRequires Shizuku authorization.

Determines which screen to enter on boot based on the phone\'s fold state at the time; \"Not set\" = left to the fold sensor.\n\nUses the same command set as \"Fold Mode\"; Shizuku must already be ready at the moment of boot.

Pins the orientation of the phone's own screen: Lock Landscape / Lock Portrait keeps it fixed; Auto-Rotate = no interference.

Only controls the phone's inner screen, not the external screen — the external screen always follows the phone's physical orientation.

When re-enabling "Auto-rotate" in the system quick settings dropdown, this will automatically follow back to auto mode.

The external screen ignores orientation requested by the app itself and only rotates according to the phone\'s physical orientation.\n\nOnly appears when phone orientation is locked. If an app displays in the wrong orientation on the external screen, try enabling this.

When the external screen image orientation is incorrect, tap 0° / 90° / 180° / 270° one by one to see which angle displays correctly, then enter it into \"Lock Portrait To / Lock Landscape To\" above.\n\n\"Restore System Auto-Rotate\" = hand the external screen back to the system to manage.

When the external screen image is shifted overall and only a corner remains on screen, tap once to restore immediately.\n\nNormally not needed — the app rearranges automatically after connecting a screen, folding, or unfolding.

Modify the phone inner screen resolution to match the aspect ratio of the inner and outer screens, eliminating black borders or stretching.

Enter as "Width × Height", oriented based on the external screen standing upright — a 1920×1080 landscape panel should be entered as 1080×1920. Leave DPI empty or enter 0 = keep unchanged.

"Inner Screen Resolution Override" is an independent toggle; applied immediately upon enabling.

Sets upper and lower bounds for inner screen refresh rate, replacing system adaptive behavior: entering 120 for both locks at 120Hz; entering 60 for both locks at 60Hz. \"Return to System\" deletes these values and returns control to the system.\n\n⚠ Rates exceeding 60Hz only take effect when the inner screen is detected; when closed, the cover screen is active and only supports 60Hz.
Reads native pixel dimensions of the external screen panel, converts them to portrait, and automatically fills them into the input fields above.

Resolutions applied via \"Apply Now\" are manually set and won\'t be cleared automatically upon disconnecting or rebooting; those applied via connect prompt or auto-apply are restored upon disconnecting.\n\nIf similar apps like SecondScreen are installed, please set them to manual mode — two sources writing display parameters simultaneously causes display misalignment.

App takes over fold state: content transfers to cover screen when folded, returns to inner screen when unfolded. \"Restore Auto\" = return control to fold sensor.\n\nRequires Shizuku authorization. To keep both inner and outer screens lit simultaneously with the cover screen acting as an interactive secondary desktop, use \"Launch Dual-Screen Mode\" in the \"Dual-Screen\" tab.
Some features require adb or root permissions. adb uses Shizuku: authorize this app in Shizuku and keep it running; root uses Magisk.
Current values of screen parameters and permissions for this app.

Switches to concurrent dual screens and projects a secondary desktop to the cover screen (complete with clock, battery, and app icons). Tap icons on the cover screen to open apps on that display.\n\nSystem built-in concurrency only lights up the cover screen with an empty idle interface. Requires Shizuku authorization.

An app grid on the cover screen; tap icons to open directly on that screen without unfolding your phone first.\n\nPin it to the cover screen in \"Settings → Cover Screen\" (see next note); tap gear on toolbar to enter settings. App launching and uninstallation both use Shizuku.

Cover Screen Launcher config page: pick apps, arrange order, adjust appearance. Changes reflect immediately on the cover screen grid.

Tap icon = add or remove, top-left is favorites; long-press icon to favorite or uninstall, drag directly to reorder, which automatically switches to manual order.

Top bar image icon sets background image; once set, both config page and widget update. "Opacity" adjusts darkness of the black overlay on top of the image. Icon shape must be set to "Circle" to unify all icons.

Note: Uninstalling apps requires Shizuku.

You need to pin this widget on the cover screen yourself once.

In "Settings → Cover Screen", check "Cover Screen Launcher" (may be labeled "Widgets" or "Cover Screen Apps"), close the phone, swipe to the widget page on the cover screen; if not visible, tap "+" on the page, select it from the list, and drag to place it.

Pin once: checking or unchecking apps in the config page will automatically update this grid afterwards.

Remembers parameters for each external monitor by screen identity, automatically applying them next time this display is recognized.

"Save Current Screen Settings" = save current configuration. Matching uses screen identity rather than port number, so it is recognized even when plugged into a different port.

"Orientation Sync" and "Auto-Rotate" are only recorded and won't be toggled for you upon connecting; "Prompt on Screen Connect" and "Auto-Restore on Disconnect" similarly are not saved per-screen.

Experimental features centered around the cover screen; details may change at any time. Most require Shizuku permissions.\n\nSecondary screen and dual-screen contents have been moved to the \"Dual-Screen\" tab on the main interface.

Projects secondary screen desktop (a full page of app grid) onto the cover screen.\n\nOnly casts content without switching the phone into dual-screen mode; current active screen and fold state remain untouched. Secondary screen refers to the cover screen; requires Shizuku to be active.

Opens Samsung DeX desktop on the portable monitor when connected, while the phone itself operates normally.

The system does not expose a third-party API to "open DeX"; this uses a community-wide method whose success depends on the system; the exact command-line output is displayed below.

Must connect portable screen first; some system versions reject this citing "root required", in which case you must use the system's built-in entry point.

Force override for the folded cover screen: resolution, DPI, and display orientation.

"Apply Override" takes effect, "Restore Default" resets to native panel values.

Deviating too far from native values causes screen stretching or clipping.
Logical resolution and DPI for the cover screen. Enter numbers for both width and height; leave DPI blank to keep unchanged.\n\nThe screen flashes momentarily upon applying, which is normal.
Save frequently used resolutions as presets. Tap a row = apply parameters; long-press a row = delete; top-right can add or restore factory presets.\n\nUp to 12 presets stored.

Force rotate the cover screen to a specified orientation.\n\n\"Rotate 90°\" cycles through 0°→90°→180°→270°, returning to origin after four rotations; \"Clear Fixed Angle\" unpins fixed angle and returns control to system.

Cover screen content does not rotate with phone orientation by default; this toggle enables automatic rotation.

On: Phone held sideways, cover screen rotates accordingly, returning upright when turned back. Off: Restores original orientation.

Note: Relies on Shizuku for rotation commands; Accessibility service must be running; independent of inner screen "Auto-Rotate".
Connect physical keys and custom commands here: after selecting key and action, tap button on card to complete connection in system settings.\n\nManage custom commands in the card below.

Bind actions to physical keys: Power button uses system "Digital Assistant", volume keys use Accessibility service.

Select key to configure first, tap "Select Action" to pick an action, then follow page prompts to complete setup in system. Volume key action list includes "None" to unbind actions.

Note: Only one Digital Assistant can be active; setting this replaces the previous one.
Saved commands appear in the \"Side Key Actions\" action list and can be assigned to keys.\n\nNote: Commands run as shell identity; capabilities depend on permissions granted to Shizuku.

Fill in action below, include action_key in parameters.\n\nOnly the built-in actions listed below are supported; custom commands should be entered as custom:<id>, where id is shown to the right of command name.

Extends each app's display into the camera cutout safe area so the system no longer overlays a black bar.

Tap once to dispatch to all installed apps; hundreds of packages take 10-20 seconds, during which progress is shown below; apps must be relaunched to take effect.

Note: Executed via Shizuku; may fail across system updates.

When closed, swipe up from bottom center of cover screen, pause briefly and release to open Recent Tasks; release immediately to return home, swipe down or horizontally to cancel.\n\nRequires Accessibility service; turning off toggle or disconnecting Accessibility removes gesture bar immediately.

Triggers on release; does nothing if unselected. Panel keeps as many items as checked, order matches the four rows; three animation styles with identical functions.\n\nNote: Notifications require separate \"Notification Access\", distinct from Accessibility; touches on the trigger strip are intercepted, requires Accessibility service to attach.

Swipe inward from left/right edges = Back, swipe up from bottom = Home, swipe up and hold = Recents.\n\nNote: Bottom-left and bottom-right corners ignore gestures in landscape to prevent palm accidental touches while gaming; entire edge is active in portrait. Edge touches are briefly captured; non-inward swipes are returned immediately to underlying app; requires Accessibility service, works best paired with \"Hide 3-Button Navigation\".

Hides 3-button navigation bar on both desktop and cover screen simultaneously, freeing screen bottom for custom full-screen gestures.\n\nNote: Writes system settings via Shizuku; users with Good Lock installed must first turn off \"Show and hide button\" in NavStar, otherwise it will revert. Swiping up from bottom after hiding still brings it up briefly.
Switch to folded and return to cover home
Z Flip Portable Screen Extension (Beta Labs)
When enabled, long-press volume up or down to trigger cover screen shortcuts. Short presses are unaffected; long press is unaffected if no action is assigned to that side.

Determines which pseudo-apps appear on the secondary screen desktop.\n\nPseudo-apps are our own internal pages, not real apps: pinned only to the front of the secondary desktop grid, absent from system, cover launcher, and search.

A real-time status panel on the secondary screen: CPU usage with past 1-minute graph, temperature, RAM, cluster frequencies, main screen refresh rate, with time and battery on the top bar.

No Shizuku or extra permissions required; this page keeps screen on as an always-on dashboard.

Colors reflect readings: turns yellow at 50% usage / 45°C temp, turns red at 80% usage / 60°C temp.
Play any song on your phone and this page will follow and display it.
\"Notification Access\" required to read media player.
Cannot read screen info: verify Shizuku is running and authorized
Target screen is the current screen, command ignored
Slide blindly to move — cursor is on inner screen
Cannot read inner screen info, check if Shizuku is running
Missing \"Display over other apps\" permission, cannot draw cursor on inner screen
Cursor failed to attach: check overlay permission or reopen this page later
⚠ Touch running on slow path · Tap here to enable Accessibility (or connect Shizuku) for smooth dragging
Find \"Z Flip Portable Screen Extension\" in list and turn on toggle; check Shizuku as well
Slide = Move cursor · Tap = Click · Hold = Long press · Hold & Drag = Drag · Two fingers up/down = Scroll · Two fingers left/right = Page
\"Reset Inner Resolution\" takes effect on next cast start (frame dimensions are locked upon casting)
Tap \"Start Casting\" and the inner screen will appear here
Cannot read inner screen info, verify Shizuku is running
Shizuku authorization required: unable to read inner screen dimensions, taps will misalign
Shizuku not connected, must use system dialog — which is unreachable on secondary screen; please tap \"Start Casting\" on the inner screen instead
Cast permission denied (permission cancelled or rejected)
⚠ Inner screen is off, cast shows black screen — unfold phone first
Tap / drag directly on screen · Pinch with two fingers to zoom when \"Allow Zoom\" is checked

Operate phone inner screen even when closed or using only this screen: casts display onto this screen with direct tapping and dragging.

Connect Shizuku, then tap "Start Casting".
"Fullscreen" fills current screen; check "Reset Inner Resolution" to truly eliminate black bars. Controls are hidden in fullscreen; swipe down from top of screen to exit.

Notes:
· Cast permission must be granted every time; without Shizuku the dialog cannot be reached on secondary screen and must be granted on inner screen.
· Casting displays black if inner screen is off (e.g. phone closed).
· Opening this page on inner screen mirrors itself and will automatically move to the other screen.
· "Reset Inner Resolution" temporarily changes inner screen resolution and restores it upon stopping; if app is force-closed, tap restore under "Inner Screen Resolution" in main interface.
· Single-finger tapping remains accurate after zooming; introducing a second finger ignores the tap to avoid misclicks.
· Sidebar and gesture bars on cover screen are temporarily hidden during fullscreen and return upon exit.
Tap input field on inner screen first, then return here to type

Use cover screen as laptop touchpad, cursor displayed on target screen; blind swiping on panel without looking.

Tap = Click, hold 0.55s = Long press, hold & slide = Drag, two-finger vertical swipe = Scroll, two-finger horizontal swipe = Page.

Note: Injection prioritizes Shizuku, falls back to alternative paths if unavailable.

Cursor is an overlay window on inner screen requiring "Display over other apps" permission.

Path: System Settings → Apps → This App → Display over other apps (some systems place under "Special app access").

You can still enter this page without it, but cursor won't appear.

Type on cover screen to send text to cursor position in inner screen app.

Tap input field on inner screen first, return here to type, then tap "Send". Non-ASCII and emojis paste via clipboard; pure English and numbers type directly.

Note: Unfocused input fields on inner screen cannot receive text; "Send" transmits entire content in text box, then clears.

When connected to an unremembered Wi-Fi on cover screen, use this to toggle system Wireless Debugging so Shizuku can start. This button only enables, requires Accessibility permission.\n\nNote: On first enable on current network, inner screen automatically unfolds to dismiss system confirmation dialog, then refolds; subsequent connections on same network toggle directly. Automated tapping only operates during this action.

One-step execution of \"Launch Dual-Screen Mode → Open Cast Control → Fullscreen → Start Casting\".\n\nNote: Switches dual-screen mode, affecting inner screen focus; cast permission handled upfront via Shizuku, otherwise must be granted on inner screen.

Run apps on cover screen at native size: normal font size, dialogs stay on-screen and tappable.\n\nApps not added can still run on cover screen, but will scale: text fluctuates in size, some dialogs render offscreen and become untappable.

On = Run this app on cover screen at native size.

Repair All = Enable all. Reset All = Restore to list prior to this app's first modification; cannot reset if never modified.

Note: Modifies Samsung's list (Settings → Cover Screen → Apps allowed on cover screen), not this app's own settings.
